title: What browser multiplayer or co-op games deserve more players? Looking for recommendations and developers to partner with!
author: Zer0Death5
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
I’m one of the people building Co-Op Now (https://co-op.now), and I’d love some recommendations from this community.

Our ambition is to become a starting point for multiplayer gaming: somewhere to find people you click with, discover games that fit your tastes, and actually get a session going. We want to turn “we should play something sometime” into an evening spent playing together, instead of another evening spent scrolling through games.

We now have over 900 registered users. The platform is currently free to use, and we aren’t charging anyone. Longer term, we want it to cover its own running costs so we can keep developing it sustainably, potentially through an optional membership.

One thing we’d love to offer over time is genuinely fun browser-based multiplayer and co-op games, playable directly on the platform. You could meet people, find something you all want to play, and jump into it together.

So, what games should we be looking at? Small indie projects and hidden gems are very welcome. What’s a browser game you’ve played with friends that made everyone want another round?

And if you’re developing something that could fit, I’d love to hear from you too. Given this community, I’m especially curious about multiplayer projects people are building with AI-assisted development tools.

We’d love to explore partnerships with developers who would be open to integrating their games into Co-Op Now, potentially as part of that future membership. Any integration and commercial arrangement would be something we agree on together.

If you have a  or a project of your own, share a link and tell me what makes it fun to play together!
